events.summary: The advisory issued May 15, 2025 placed Japan at Level 1: Exercise Normal Precautions. It advised United States citizens to exercise caution when traveling abroad.
events.title: Japan travel advisory issued May 15, 2025

events.summary: The Department of Commerce published final results of its first five-year reviews of existing methionine antidumping duty orders for France, Japan and Spain. It found that revoking the orders would likely lead to continued or recurring dumping. The notice states that the results apply from October 5, 2026.
events.title: Final methionine antidumping review results for France, Japan and Spain

sources.supports: The complete advisory feed entry supplies the publication date, country, advisory level and precaution wording. This record describes that dated issuance; it does not establish a new announcement or a live advisory level.
sources.title: Japan travel advisory issued May 15, 2025

sources.publisher: Department of Commerce / Government Publishing Office
sources.supports: The complete notice establishes publication and applicability on October 5, 2026 and final results concerning existing orders. Signature and filing dates are separate. The listed margins describe the dumping likely if orders were revoked, not new tariff or cash-deposit rates. Full product scope is referred to a memorandum not reviewed here. Conflicting June initiation-date references are omitted. France, Japan and Spain are explicit relevance associations, not event locations.
sources.title: Federal Register notice 2026-20384: Methionine antidumping review results
